cases.description: No action description was provided at all, so there's no basis to assess what will actually happen with this content — this must be stated explicitly, not silently treated as safe.
cases.grounding: engine report: classification.uncertain=True, evidence includes 'No action description provided — cannot assess authorization requirement.'
cases.assumptions: Assuming the caller simply omitted the action rather than intending a truly no-op action; either way, the missing information is disclosed, not guessed.

cases.description: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL — this is the fail-closed default for inconclusive input; the content itself is otherwise low-sensitivity, but the missing action description is the deciding factor.
cases.grounding: classification.suggested_verdict='REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL' despite classification.sensitivity='low' and zero secret/PII/path matches.
